info.name: CCD Voice Automation - Utility Service
info.description:
All endpoints of the CCD (Card & Consignment Delivery) inbound voice bot utility service.

**Folders**
0. Health & dashboard auth
1. Workflow APIs for AutomationEdge (JSON + `twiml`)
2. Twilio webhooks, simulated with form-encoded Twilio fields
3. Twilio REST call management
4. Dashboard APIs (login first)

Every value is a variable. Import **CCD Voice - Local.postman_environment.json** and set `dashboardPassword` there.
Seed data comes from `db/seed.sql` (`npm run db:init`).

**Optional call settings** (any request; .env is the fallback):
`voice`, `language`, `agentNumber` (alias `destination`), `callerId`, `dialTimeout`, `gatherTimeout`,
`verifyTimeout`, `confidenceThreshold`, `deliveryWindow`, `baseUrl`, `menuActionUrl`, `verifyActionUrl`, `dialStatusUrl`.
Settings sent with a `callSid` are remembered for the rest of that call.

item.name: 0. Health & Dashboard Auth
item.description: Service health and dashboard sign-in. Postman keeps the session cookie automatically, so run **Login** before the Dashboard folder.

request.description: Returns `ok` when the service and PostgreSQL are reachable, `degraded` (503) otherwise. No login required.
Signs in to the dashboard and sets the HttpOnly `ccd_session` cookie. 5 wrong attempts lock the IP for 5 minutes.
Returns the signed-in user. 401 when not signed in.

item.name: 2. Twilio Webhooks (simulated)
item.description:
These are the URLs Twilio calls. Requests use Twilio's form-encoded fields so you can simulate a full call from Postman. Run them in order with the same `{{twilioSimCallSid}}`.

Call settings can be added to any webhook URL as query parameters, e.g. `?voice=Polly.Aditi&agentNumber=%2B91...`.

If `TWILIO_VALIDATE_SIGNATURE=true`, these simulated requests are rejected (403).

request.description: Configure this URL in the Twilio Console under **A Call Comes In (POST)**. Looks up the caller by `From` and returns the greeting TwiML.
Keypad: 1 status, 2 delivery date, 3 attempt history, 4 documents / next steps, 9 agent, 0 end call, * repeat menu.

urlencoded.value: Why wasn't my card delivered yesterday?

request.description: Speech is classified into STATUS / EDD / EXCEPTION / ACTION / AGENT / RESCHEDULE / NO. `Confidence` below the threshold counts as unclear.
Empty Gather result (caller said nothing). First time re-prompts; second time escalates (or ends the call politely at the follow-up question).
Gather action for secondary verification. Send `Digits` (keypad) or `SpeechResult` (spoken). Two failures escalate to an agent.

item.name: Verify Input - spoken date of birth

exec: pm.test('Busy message', () => pm.expect(xml).to.include('All agents are currently busy'));

request.description: `<Dial action>` callback. `busy`, `no-answer`, `failed` or `canceled` play "All agents are currently busy" and hang up; `completed` just hangs up.
Configure under **Call Status Changes (POST)** in Twilio. Records final duration and marks unfinished calls as ABANDONED. Clears `twilioSimCallSid` so the next run starts a new call.

item.name: 3. Call Management (Twilio REST)
item.description: Uses the Twilio REST API with the credentials in .env. Needs real `TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID` / `TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN` and a Twilio number.

request.description:
Places a call via `client.calls.create`.

- `to` (required, E.164)
- `from` (default TWILIO_PHONE_NUMBER)
- `actionUrl` (default: this service's inbound-call webhook; call settings are appended as query parameters)
- `method`, `statusCallback`, `statusCallbackMethod`, `statusCallbackEvent`, `timeout` (5-600), `record`, `machineDetection`

Empty strings fall back to defaults.

**Optional call settings** (any request; .env is the fallback):
`voice`, `language`, `agentNumber` (alias `destination`), `callerId`, `dialTimeout`, `gatherTimeout`,
`verifyTimeout`, `confidenceThreshold`, `deliveryWindow`, `baseUrl`, `menuActionUrl`, `verifyActionUrl`, `dialStatusUrl`.
Settings sent with a `callSid` are remembered for the rest of that call.
Live status (`queued`, `ringing`, `in-progress`, `completed`...), duration and timestamps for a real Twilio CallSid (`CA` + 32 hex). `twilioCallSid` is filled in by **Make Call**.
Ends an active call (`status: completed`).

item.name: 4. Dashboard APIs (login required)
item.description: Run **0. Health & Dashboard Auth / Login** first (running the whole collection does this automatically). Without the session cookie these return 401. **Logout** is the last request.

request.description: Containment rate, total calls, AHT, validation accuracy, escalation rate, cost savings, plus chart data.

Query: `limit` (1-200), `offset`, `q` (search), `from` / `to` (YYYY-MM-DD), `disposition` (BOT_RESOLVED, CALLER_ENDED, AGENT_TRANSFERRED, AGENT_UNAVAILABLE, ABANDONED, IN_PROGRESS), `validation` (ANI, ANI_MULTI, CONSIGNMENT, DOB, FAILED, WORKFLOW). Caller numbers are masked.
Same filters as Audit Logs; up to 50,000 rows. In Postman use **Send and Download** to save the file.
Turn-by-turn events for one call (intents, verification results, escalation). `auditCallSid` is set by **Audit Logs**.
Clears the dashboard session cookie. Requests in this folder return 401 afterwards until you Login again.
